title: I Used the Hold-Shelf Camera on the Patron Who Hid the Cookbook

parts.text: I asked for my hold at 11:18 a.m. and the cookbook was not on the shelf. A patron two feet away had it tucked behind the large-print romances, still with my name slip. The library posts that holds are camera-covered to stop hiding. I was fifty-four, card in hand. I pointed at the camera and the slip. The clerk retrieved it without a speech. The patron said they were still deciding. Holds are decided. I checked it out. The romances went back to romance. The camera did what the sign promised, which is rare and enough. I will make the soup from page 40. Deciding can happen after the slip expires. Not during my name.

social.description: Hold camera, tucked cookbook, still deciding. The clerk did not need a speech. Have you hunted your own slip?
